quantization.method: PT2E dynamic activation/static weight reduced-range experiment

weight.granularity: per-output-channel symmetric (one group per output row)
weight.packing: XNNPACK serialized qint4; require package <=65% of matched INT8 as packing evidence

quantization.calibration: The pinned prefill/decode fixtures would be executed after prepare_pt2e; dynamic activation qparams need no reusable calibration range. Full-model calibration is gated on a genuinely packed INT4 representation.
quantization.acceptance_gate: Require packed nibbles, an explicit fixed group size, XNNPACK delegation, and at least 35% package reduction versus accepted INT8 before prefill.

coverage.serialized_packing: not applicable: stage has no Linear weights

criteria.rationale: INT8 is evaluated against pinned eager FP32, not the FP32 delegate tolerance. Cosine >=0.99 protects direction for hidden/logit/cache vectors, aggregate NRMSE <=5% bounds energy-weighted drift, per-cache NRMSE <=12% covers low-energy value caches without hiding it, and the externally consumed greedy token must match exactly.

INT8 is evaluated against pinned eager FP32, not the FP32 delegate tolerance. Cosine >=0.99 protects direction for hidden/logit/cache vectors, aggregate NRMSE <=5% bounds energy-weighted drift, per-cache NRMSE <=12% covers low-energy value caches without hiding it, and the externally consumed greedy token must match exactly.

size_and_fallback_acceptance.criterion: all Linear ops use the four-bit range and package <=65% of INT8

conclusion: Rejected for deployment: at least one numerical, token, determinism, delegation, or packing criterion failed; integration falls back to accepted INT8.
quality_risk: High: per-channel full-row INT4 exceeds the locked aggregate and per-cache error limits; matching the first greedy token does not establish autoregressive speech quality.
integration_fallback: accepted INT8 XNNPACK package from qwen2-int8-host.json
